title: Add RBACv2 diff tool, offline KMS consent simulator, and audit sanity checker
author: Priya Narayanan
release_notes: Add RBACv2 policy diffing utility (CLI + service), an offline KMS consent simulator for dry-running residency and consent checks, and an audit sanity checker that flags missing immutable headers and replay anomalies.
description: Motivation: We've seen frequent operator confusion during RBACv2 rollouts where small policy edits have unexpected residency or KMS consent implications. This PR delivers three developer/operator-facing tools to reduce rollout risk: 1) an RBACv2 diff tool (CLI + optional HTTP service) that highlights semantic changes (role inheritance, constraint changes, region/zone pins) instead of raw YAML diffs; 2) an offline KMS consent simulator that performs a dry-run of policy evaluations against a configurable set of tenant/residency scenarios and emits consent decisions and suggested fallbacks; 3) an audit sanity checker that scans request/ingest traces to detect missing audit headers, non-deterministic audit ordering, and probable replay windows. Summary of changes: - tools/rbac-diff: CLI and lightweight server with a policy-normalizer and semantic comparison engine. Produces structured reports with severity and suggested remediation steps. - tools/kms-consent-sim: Python-based simulator for local dev and CI that can replay historical requests against new policy sets to surface consent failures. - pkg/audit: added sanity_check.go with heuristics for missing immutable headers, duplicate sequence IDs, and anomalous timestamp skews; added lightweight auto-mitigation advisory generator. - pkg/policy/linter: RBACv2-specific lints for region pinning, tenant-scoped KMS usage, and operator-scoped role templates. - docs/security: onboarding guide for using the diff tool and simulator during canary rollouts and post-incident triage. Testing and rollout: unit + integration tests included; demo Canary run executed in staging against a production-like policy bundle; CI initially reported flaky integration tests (flaky DB transaction timing) which were fixed by adding a deterministic policy seed and a retry wrapper. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-3421) [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] security review requested (SEC-1187) [x] docs updated [x] staged canary performed in staging and observed no regressions Related work: this PR complements the policy-simulator work (ENG-2980) and the residency telemetry plumbing (ENG-3199). Migration notes: operators should run the RBAC diff against each release candidate and optionally run the KMS consent simulator against a sample of tenant policies prior to canary. The audit sanity checker is safe to enable in passive mode initially; it only emits advisories and does not block traffic. Linear/Jira: ENG-3421, SEC-1187, SUP-4129. Merge: squash merge after final approvals.
